tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's id and email as seen by the MCP server.

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.title: List my Luma calendars
tools.description: List the signed-in user's connected calendars (Luma API-linked, Eventbrite, Meetup, or scraped). Use mine=true to only get calendars marked as the user's own.

mine.description: Filter to calendars marked as the user's own (true) or not (false).

tools.name: list_events
tools.title: List my events
tools.description: List the signed-in user's consolidated (canonical) events across all connected calendars. Filter by mine (only events from calendars marked as the user's own), calendar_id, or temporal status.

mine.description: true = only events from calendars marked as mine; false = only from calendars not marked as mine.

calendar_id.description: Restrict to a single calendar (its public calendar_id from list_calendars).

tools.name: list_my_badges
tools.title: List my generated badges
tools.description: List badges the signed-in user has generated, most recent first. Optionally filter by event_id.

event_id.description: Filter to a specific Luma event id.

tools.name: list_event_style_presets
tools.title: List style presets for an event
tools.description: List saved AI style presets (palette, fonts, mood) for a given Luma event id owned by the signed-in user.

event_id.description: Luma event id, e.g. evt-abc123 or scr-xyz.
